verified_facts: National Polygon Service contains National Polygon, Title Descriptor and Title Number/UPRN Look Up datasets
National Polygon extents are indicative and every freehold or leasehold title has at least one index polygon
monthly full, change-only and validation assets are distinct delivery roles
National Polygon fields are Shape, Poly_ID, Title_No, INSERT, UPDATE, Vers_No and Rec_Status
Rec_Status values distinguish Added, Changed and Deleted
one title can relate to one or more index polygons and the extent is not a definitive legal boundary
Title Number/UPRN Look Up links HMLR title numbers to AddressBase UPRNs where an address relationship can be made
Title_No and UPRN are separate mandatory fields
absence of a match is not evidence that a registered title does not exist
Title Descriptor fields distinguish title number, estate interest, class of title, registered status and change indicator
a title can have only one class of title
pending registration can have a title number without estate or class information
INSPIRE Index Polygons are an open freehold-only subset for England and Wales
files are divided by local authority and boundary polygons may appear in more than one file
Land Registry INSPIRE ID is distinct from title number
INSPIRE data is updated monthly
the dataset contains locations of freehold registered property in England and Wales
it is a subset of the wider Index Polygons database
National Polygon gives indicative boundary shape and position
Title Descriptor supplies legal interest and class-of-title information
Title Number/UPRN Look Up supplies property reference associations
Geographical Names contains Crowd Sourced Name Point, Named Area, Named Point and Named Road Junction
representations of the same named feature share an OSID
named features support gazetteer and high-level spatial analysis rather than property ownership evidence
Named Area settlement extents are geographic depictions and not official administrative or electoral boundaries
coverage is Great Britain with EPSG:27700 default CRS
updates can be up to daily and lifecycle identifiers are supplied
Named Area is a polygon representation of a named settlement, locality, feature or water area
Extent Definition records geometry confidence/generation context
earliest consistent temporal snapshot is 29 September 2022
Named Point is a point representation linked to the corresponding Named Area
bounding-box fields describe the corresponding Named Area minimum bounding rectangle
language and local-authority attributes are separate from geometry
Named Road Junction is a MultiPoint name representation of a junction or roundabout
a junction may be official, numbered or modelled from intersecting road names
earliest consistent temporal snapshot is 27 March 2024
Crowd Sourced Name Point contains unofficial vernacular names submitted through the Vernacular Names Tool
matched OSID, UPRN and USRN fields are nullable associations
proper names and authoritative addresses require authoritative linked identifiers
crowd-sourced coverage depends on submissions and names are not standardised by OS
duplicate submitted names can all be published
Named Area is not a definitive administrative boundary dataset
known linking issues can affect Crowd Sourced Name Point associations
updates are delivered through standard change-only updates
documented known issues require fail-closed handling
UPRN is the primary identifier for the Address theme
address identifiers and named-feature OSIDs serve different identity domains
UPRN matching does not turn a name feature into an authoritative address record
Matched UPRN Method uses an explicit code list
different matching methods distinguish spatial or interpreted association
matching method provenance must be retained
dataset and file metadata are exposed separately
National Polygon Service has its own dataset identity
file size and technical specification references are metadata rather than parcel evidence
